source.dataset_name: Chan-Lam coupling of primary sulfonamides with boronic acids

protocol.reaction_class: Chan-Lam coupling of primary sulfonamides with boronic acids

steps.vessel: 8 x 30 mm glass vial insert in a 96 well-plate Para-dox Aluminum Reaction Block

meta.evidence: First, the catalysts (2 umol per vial) and solid bases (20 umol per vial) were added by dosing 50 uL each of a stock solution in 1,2-dichloroethane
First, the catalysts (2 umol per vial) and solid bases (20 umol per vial) were added by dosing 50 uL each of a stock solution in 1,2-dichloroethane
The 1,2-dichloroethane was then removed via centrifugal evaporation using a Genevac EZ-2 evaporator (Scientific Products)(method: low boiling point, maximum temperature of 30 C, 10-30 minutes).

Stock solutions of sulfonamide and boronic acid (0.1 M in sulfonamide, 0.15 M in boronic acid) were prepared in the respective reaction solvent (MeCN, MeOH, DCE, or EtOAc) and 100 uL were dosed into the reaction plate according to the design.

Stock solutions of sulfonamide and boronic acid (0.1 M in sulfonamide, 0.15 M in boronic acid) were prepared in the respective reaction solvent (MeCN, MeOH, DCE, or EtOAc) and 100 uL were dosed into the reaction plate according to the design.

Stock solutions of sulfonamide and boronic acid (0.1 M in sulfonamide, 0.15 M in boronic acid) were prepared in the respective reaction solvent (MeCN, MeOH, DCE, or EtOAc) and 100 uL were dosed into the reaction plate according to the design.
Lastly, liquid bases were dispensed manually via single-channel pipette.
The reaction block was sealed and the contents were tumble-stirred at ~600 rpm (3-Position Magnetic Tumble Stirrer, U.S. Series, V&P Scientific, Inc.) for 18 hours at 60 C.
After the reaction time had elapsed, the plate was removed from the heat. Upon cooling
Upon cooling, 500 uL of biphenyl stock solution (0.05 M in MeCN, 0.25 equiv) was added to each well as external standard.

steps.sampling_conditions: Sample from each reaction well via multi-channel pipettor, taking care not to agitate the solution.

meta.evidence: Taking care not to agitate the solution, 25 uL from each well was sampled via multi-channel pipettor and dispensed into a Thermo Scientific(TM) 96-well 1 mL polypropylene plate (SKU 278743) for analysis.
Each well was diluted with 750 uL MeCN

unresolved: The procedure describes a reaction screen rather than identifying individual reagents for a particular well. The aliases catalysts, sulfonamide, boronic acid, and liquid bases align with the supplied component structures and roles, but the specific chemical identities are not named in the procedure.

Components r3 and r6 have identical solvent identities. Assigning r3 to the initial stock-solution solvent and r6 to the reaction-solvent dosing distinguishes the two explicit solvent-use stages, but the procedure does not distinguish these component IDs.
The generic procedure includes solid-base dosing, but no supplied component is identifiable as a solid base. No additional initial reagent was invented.
The evaporation specifies a maximum temperature of 30 C and a duration range of 10-30 minutes, not an actual temperature or a single duration; these were not encoded as scalar operating parameters.
The stated stirring speed is approximate (~600 rpm).
The cooling endpoint and cooling duration are unspecified.
The sulfonamide, boronic acid, and reaction solvent are dosed as stock solutions; their separate Add entries do not imply separate sequential dispensing.
Step 1 represents 1,2-dichloroethane delivered as the catalyst and solid-base stock carrier, not an independent additional solvent dose. The source specifies 50 uL of each applicable stock per vial.

The DCE reaction-solvent selection at step 5 is unresolved from this source alone. MeCN, MeOH, DCE, and EtOAc are alternatives assigned by the referenced screening design; no particular well's selection is provided here.
